cohort: 997 mothers and their live-born neonates (261 preterm deliveries and 736 term deliveries) at Fatemieh Hospital in Hamadan, Iran, in 2019
finding: Maternal factors such as academic education, age (25-34 years and 35 years and above), previous preterm delivery, history of abortion, history of surgery, history of infertility, and history of cesarean delivery were associated with a higher odds of preterm delivery.
mod_finding: A history of cesarean section was associated with higher odds of preterm delivery.
